clarification: The percentages are shares of all surveyed U.S. adults, not shares within the 22% group. The 22% is the broad set of respondents who moved, had someone move in, or knew someone who moved; only 3% said they personally moved. The right-hand categories can overlap.
verified_detail: Distinguish the broad 22% statistic from the 3% that personally moved, with the same survey denominator or a clear equivalent statement.
